mods.title: {{name}} — Mods
mods.description: Install and manage mods in this server's data folder.

config.description: Edit serverconfig.json. Changes apply on the next restart.
config.saved: serverconfig.json saved. Restart the server to apply changes.

settings.dangerDescription: Deleting an instance is permanent. You can optionally also delete all server data (worlds, mods, config).
settings.stopBeforeDelete: Stop the server before deleting it
settings.deleteDescription: This action cannot be undone. The instance configuration will be permanently removed.
settings.deleteDataDescription: Worlds, mods and config are removed from disk.

whitelist.enabled: Enabled — only whitelisted players can join
whitelist.emptyDescription: Add a player below or bulk-import a whitelist file.
whitelist.removeCommandFailed: Player removed from file but live command failed (server may not be responding)
whitelist.addCommandFailed: Player added to file but live command failed (server may not be responding)
whitelist.bulkDescription: Paste a JSON array of { uid, name } entries, or an object with an entries array.
whitelist.errorNotArray: expected a JSON array or an { entries: [...] } object
whitelist.errorNoEntries: no entries with a uid found

restarts.title: Restarts
restarts.autoHint: Bring the server back up after an unexpected exit (up to 5 attempts).
restarts.scheduleHint: Restart once a day at this local time.

moderation.title: Player moderation
moderation.description: Kick, ban or unban a player by name or UID; the server applies it immediately.
moderation.notRunning: Start the server to moderate players.
